symbols.name: first vector space
symbols.meaning: A complex vector space, the first factor of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ and $F$ be vector spaces over $\mathbb{C}$.

symbols.name: second vector space
symbols.meaning: A complex vector space, the second factor of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ and $F$ be vector spaces over $\mathbb{C}$.

symbols.name: general vector of E
symbols.meaning: An arbitrary vector of E, not a basis vector.
symbols.quote: Every $e\in E$ is a general vector of $E$, and every $f\in F$ a general vector of $F$.

symbols.name: general vector of F
symbols.meaning: An arbitrary vector of F, not a basis vector.
symbols.quote: Every $e\in E$ is a general vector of $E$, and every $f\in F$ a general vector of $F$.

symbols.name: basis size of E
symbols.meaning: The number of basis vectors of E, which counts the vectors e_1 through e_n.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_n$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $n$ is the number of basis vectors of $E$ (the letter changes meaning from the input length of earlier pages) and $q$ is the number of basis vectors of $F$.

symbols.name: basis size of F
symbols.meaning: The number of basis vectors of F, which counts the vectors f_1 through f_q.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_n$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $n$ is the number of basis vectors of $E$ (the letter changes meaning from the input length of earlier pages) and $q$ is the number of basis vectors of $F$.

symbols.name: basis index of E
symbols.meaning: The position of the basis vector e_i of E, running from 1 to n.
symbols.quote: Here $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, and $1\le i\le n$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis index of F
symbols.meaning: The position of the basis vector f_j of F, running from 1 to q.
symbols.quote: Here $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, and $1\le i\le n$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: linear map of E
symbols.meaning: A linear map of E, one factor of the product map.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be a linear map of $E$ and $T$ of $F$; the letters $L$ and $T$ change meaning here.

symbols.name: linear map of F
symbols.meaning: A linear map of F, the other factor of the product map.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be a linear map of $E$ and $T$ of $F$; the letters $L$ and $T$ change meaning here.

symbols.name: selected bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected bits, which counts the factors of the butterfly tensor product.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ counts the selected bits, not the address field $D$.

relations.quote: The tensor product of one-dimensional transforms is built from one [Discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) per axis.
